data.title: 品牌画廊形态
data.content: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"image-text-2","attrs":{"id":"imageText_Km4vG","src":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/5k3yid06_384901cf00f8fe2a125881052f71c04b.png","caption":"朋友圈品牌画廊营销","naturalWidth":780,"naturalHeight":1688,"imgAlign":"right"},"content":[{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"产品介绍"}]},{"type":"bulletList","content":[{"type":"listItem","content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"justify"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"Gallery 品牌画廊营销支持品牌在朋友圈进行TVC的展示，通过美轮美奂的效果营造强烈的视觉冲击、突出精致细节，吸引用户关注。"}]}]},{"type":"listItem","content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"justify"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"支持品牌从左到右展示3~7个竖版视频（9:16比例）或图片；客户可结合素材提炼强化商品/明星等亮点信息，对每个视频或图片配以自定义文案；用户左右滑动可轮换相关视频或图片，滑动至最后一张卡片时，继续左滑进入品牌落地页"}]}]}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"售卖方式"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"支持合约售卖。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"如有投放意向，可以联系你的行业 / 渠道运营经理，或拨打我们的销售热线获取帮助。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"销售热线："},{"type":"telphone","attrs":{"id":"telphone_DiYvs","telphone":4000617816},"marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":" "}]}]}]}
